localChanges: The City Status, Trade, Happiness, Military and Intelligence reports, the Civilopedia index, Load Game and the Hall of Fame now have a filter box: type to narrow the list, matching anything shown in a row, with letters in order but not necessarily together, so "musk" finds cities building Musketmen and also Murmansk. Case and accents don't matter, Escape clears the filter, and typing anywhere in the window or pressing / starts it (closes #661).
